items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...oh George.... See a lot of these guys...

ctx.x: Right. Then of course there was Hodges and Benny Carter...

Oh yeah, well, but that was another league altogether, Hodges and Benny Carter. But these are, the boys that I just mentioned was in sort of would you say the minor league, but they were good. Charlie Holmes, Tab Smith, oh George.... See a lot of these guys, there was a drummer around by the name of Dinah. I never did know Dinah's first name because everybody called him just Dinah. And another one around then named Puss Johnson, I never did know his name. Right today I don't know Puss Johnson's name, his real…
But at least they have a first name for you.
